<!--
  Fixture, not a deck.

      quarto render tests/mermaid-smoke.qmd
      python tools/check_pptx.py _site/tests/mermaid-smoke.pptx
      powershell -File tools/shoot_pptx.ps1 -Deck _site/tests/mermaid-smoke.pptx

  FINDING (2026-09-10, Quarto 1.8.25). Mermaid reaches PowerPoint, but not
  intact. Two defects, both visible in the shot of slide 2:

  1. THE SLIDE SPLITS. Quarto's diagram filter emits the rendered PNG as a
     block that pandoc's pptx writer breaks before -- so the action title and
     the diagram land on slide 2, and every shape pptx-nexer.lua builds (the
     kicker, its rule, the source rail) is pushed onto an untitled slide 3.
     The filter already defuses this for tables and bare images by wrapping
     them in a pandoc.Figure; Mermaid output arrives in some other shape and
     slips past that guard. Fixing it means teaching convert() in
     pptx-nexer.lua to recognise and wrap it too.

  2. NODE TEXT IS CLIPPED. Headless Chromium lays the boxes out with a font it
     does not have (the themeVariables fontFamily below), so every label is cut
     off mid-word: "Intak", "Build on platf", "Scale and monit".

  Until both are fixed, draw diagrams with ggplot2 instead -- the
  ggplot-diagrams skill and R/nexer-diagrams.R: same palette, same fonts as
  the charts, and it goes through the image path the filter already handles.
  Reveal.js renders the Mermaid below correctly -- the defects are
  PowerPoint-only. Re-run this after a Quarto upgrade: if check_pptx reports
  two slides, the split is fixed and the skill should say so.
-->
